meta.description: Architecture map for AI agents: nodes, edges, and interactive data flows

flows.name: Device Registration
flows.description: First launch: register the device and obtain a JWT saved to DataStore.

steps.label: App launch — no token
steps.description: SessionViewModel reads DataStore → deviceToken is null → navigate to BienvenidaScreen

steps.label: Fetch public sectors
steps.description: GET /api/sectors (no auth required) → returns all sectors for the picker

steps.label: POST /api/auth/device/register
steps.description: Body: { device_id: ANDROID_ID, sector_id, encargado_name }

steps.label: JWT issued (365 days)
steps.description: Backend inserts device row with approved=true → signs JWT with device payload

steps.label: Token persisted to DataStore
steps.description: AppPreferences saves token + activeSectorId. Survives app reinstall.

steps.label: Navigate to main
steps.description: Next launch: token found → BienvenidaScreen skipped entirely

flows.name: Employee Sync
flows.description: Fetches employees from the API and replaces the local Room cache for the sector.

steps.label: loadData() on init
steps.description: Reads activeSectorId from DataStore preferences

steps.label: GET /api/employees?sector_id=X
steps.description: Bearer token in Authorization header. Returns DTOs with tieneFotoFrente/Dorso booleans.

steps.label: PostgreSQL query
steps.description: SELECT where sector_id = X AND is_active = true, ordered by last_name ASC

steps.label: DTO → EmployeeEntity
steps.description: first_name + last_name merged into nombre; last_name stored separately as apellido

steps.label: Room: deleteBySector + insertAll
steps.description: Full replace for the sector — always fresh data on sync

steps.label: Flow<List<Employee>> emits
steps.description: getBySector() is a live Room query — UI recomposes automatically on any DB change

flows.name: Record Tarja
flows.description: Write-to-outbox pattern: immediate local write, async background push every 15 min.

minutesWorkedFormat.rules: hours always first segment if present; C: prefix for cosecha+cachos; AB: prefix for abonada y otros

steps.label: Hours dialog confirmed
steps.description: guardarHoras() builds minutesWorked string: '8' | '8|C:3' | '8|C:3|AB:texto observacion'

steps.label: OutboxSubmission → Room
steps.description: dedupKey = 'sectorId:employeeId:date'. INSERT OR IGNORE prevents duplicates.

steps.label: UI updates instantly
steps.description: empleadosConHorasHoy Set updated — card indicator changes without any network round-trip

steps.label: PushTarjaWorker fires (15 min)
steps.description: WorkManager periodic task reads all status=pending entries from Room

steps.label: POST /api/submissions
steps.description: Hours converted to minutes (h ≤ 16 → h × 60). Bearer JWT token in header.

steps.label: PostgreSQL UPSERT
steps.description: ON CONFLICT (employee_id, date) WHERE NOT is_deleted → UPDATE SET minutes_worked

steps.label: markSent() in Room
steps.description: OutboxSubmission status → 'sent'. countPendingFlow() decrements the badge.

flows.name: Cerrar Tarja
flows.description: Flushes all pending submissions in parallel batches of 10 and persists tarja status.

steps.label: Cerrar Tarja button tapped
steps.description: TarjaViewModel.cerrarTarja() — sets isCerrando=true immediately to block double-submit

steps.label: getAllNotSentForDate()
steps.description: Fetches pending + failed entries for today AND any other pending dates

steps.label: Parallel batches of 10
steps.description: chunked(10).map { async { ... } } + awaitAll(). Mutex protects DAO writes.

steps.label: Each POST /api/submissions
steps.description: markSent() on 2xx, markFailed() on 4xx (won't retry), incrementAttempt() on 5xx

steps.label: TarjaStatusEntity created
steps.description: enviada=true, horaEnvio=now(), empleadosTarjados count, horasTarjadas sum

steps.label: Persisted to Room
steps.description: tarjaStatusDao.upsert() → dashboard counters update via Flow observation

flows.name: Visualizador de Horas
flows.description: Period billing grid (21st → 20th): employees × dates, cosecha counts, notes.
flows.billingPeriod: 21st of previous month to 20th of current month

steps.label: Ver Horas tapped
steps.description: abrirVisualizador() — calculates current billing period (21st of prev month → 20th of this month)

steps.label: Period offset navigation
steps.description: periodoOffset lets the user scroll to past periods via arrows in the UI header

steps.label: GET /api/admin/report
steps.description: Uses hardcoded ADMIN_TOKEN (not the device JWT). Returns rows with notes field.

steps.label: Employees from Room
steps.description: getEmployeesForSector().first() — uses local cache for employee metadata, avoids extra API call

steps.label: Group + compute totals
steps.description: Grouped by employeeId → totalHoras (numeric), cosechaCount, horasPorDia Map<date, value>

steps.label: Sorted by apellido
steps.description: Fallback: last space-token of nombre for employees with blank apellido field

steps.label: Grid rendered
steps.description: Scrollable employees × dates table. celdaValor() parses '8|C:3|AB:...' into colored cells.

flows.name: DNI Photo Upload
flows.description: Camera or gallery picker → JPEG compress → multipart upload → Railway Volume.
flows.storageNote: Filenames stored as TEXT in employees.dni_foto_frente/dorso — NEVER bytea

steps.label: Camera or gallery selected
steps.description: Two launchers: TakePicture (camera) + GetContent (gallery). Gallery added so supervisors can use forwarded photo messages.

steps.label: URI → InputStream
steps.description: ContentResolver.openInputStream(uri) handles both camera temp file and gallery content URIs

steps.label: JPEG compression (quality 80)
steps.description: BitmapFactory.decode → Bitmap.compress(JPEG, 80) — reduces upload payload

steps.label: POST multipart /api/employees/{id}/foto/{lado}
steps.description: Max 8 MB. Bearer JWT token. lado = frente or dorso.

steps.label: Written to Railway Volume
steps.description: stream.pipeline(req.file, fs.createWriteStream('/data/dni/{id}_{lado}.jpg'))

steps.label: PostgreSQL updated
steps.description: UPDATE employees SET dni_foto_frente = '{filename}' WHERE id = {id}

steps.label: Room flag updated
steps.description: dao.updateFotoFrente(employeeId, true) → employee card indicator changes immediately

flows.name: Create Employee
flows.description: Local duplicate check → POST → optional sector transfer confirmation.

steps.label: FAB tapped
steps.description: abrirDialogoNuevo() clears all form state

steps.label: Local duplicate check
steps.description: getByDniAndSector() in Room — immediate. If found+active: error. If found+inactive: reactivate prompt.

steps.label: POST /api/employees
steps.description: 409 = exists in same sector. 422 + EXISTS_OTHER_SECTOR = exists in another sector.

steps.label: Transfer confirmation dialog
steps.description: On 422: dialog shown. User confirms → forceTransfer=true re-POST moves employee across sectors.

steps.label: Backend creates/transfers
steps.description: INSERT or UPDATE sector_id. If transfer: INSERT into transfers table (from/to/timestamp).

steps.label: Saved to Room
steps.description: EmployeeEntity inserted via dao.insert() — immediately visible in list via Flow

steps.label: Photos uploaded (best-effort)
steps.description: uploadFoto() called for each captured URI. Failure doesn't block creation.
